facts.text: All new undergraduate students under 21 years of age are required to live in a university residence hall for their first two years of study.

sources.title: Temporary Housing Upon Arrival - Marquette University
sources.quote: All new undergraduate students are required to live in a university residence hall during their first two years of study unless they are 21 years old or older,

facts.text: All undergraduates complete the Marquette Core Curriculum, a four-year general education program rooted in Catholic, Jesuit intellectual traditions.

sources.title: Marquette Core Curriculum
sources.quote: The Marquette Core Curriculum (MCC) is the center of every Marquette University undergraduate student's educational experience, providing a distinctive approach that is: * Grounded in the Jesuit Tradition.
